system.longDesc:
Cost: 1–3 SP

Stunts from this table are used when attacking or sabotaging a vehicle.

Your attack damages the vehicle’s Handling, Sensors, or Weapons. Impose a −1 penalty per SP spent to the damaged ability (up to 3). This penalty remains until the vehicle is repaired. Damage control with a TN 13 Intelligence (Engineering) test can negate (but not remove) the penalty for rounds equal to the Drama Die result. If the ability is reduced below −2, the vehicle automatically fails tests calling for it. If Handling is reduced below −2 the vehicle is out of control and helpless.
